run_smpl_to_mhr_conversion: run the DEMO class to convert SMPL parameters to MHR format using PyMomentum
run_smplx_mesh_to_mhr: run the DEMO class to convert SMPLX meshes to MHR format using PyTorch
run_mhr_to_smplx_conversion: run the DEMO class to convert MHR parameters back to SMPLX meshes
run_sam3d_to_smplx_conversion: run the DEMO class to convert SAM3D body output to SMPLX meshes
run_all_conversion_examples: run all SMPL SMPLX and MHR conversion examples via the CLI with argparse
